name: Shukusei no Girlfriend 2 -The Destiny Star of Girlfriend-
original_name: 宿星のガールフレンド2 -the destiny star of girlfriend-
source:
Average joe Seiji encounters another magical-girl wonderkid—this time in the form of the mysterious Maja Krienke at his neighborhood park! Intrigued by her aloof charm and possible hidden motive, he tries to say something, when a Majin appears out of nowhere to reveal Maja’s true identity—a ruthless warrioress in cahoots with evil in exchange for the darker arts...

Stunned, Seiji agrees to serve as Maja’s familiar—or “satellite”—to aid them in taking down another, rival Majin’s demon hordes. He also stands to gain an impressive array of powers, but as a trade-off, he is now tightly bound to Maja by a magical tether, connecting him to her around the clock! As fate would have it, this rope is essential for Seiji to receive a steady supply of magical force—or risk his new satellite body collapsing in the mortal realm.

Forced into cohabitation with the lovely Maja effective immediately, he soon learns of her “unique” blindspots—for better or worse, her guard stays perpetually down around our loyal but increasingly frustrated hero, resulting in plenty of questionable close calls and near-accidents... Will an unlikely summer shack-up stir up something else between them, or will Seiji forever remain her indentured servant?

[From [url=https://www.johren.games/games/download/destiny-star-girlfriend2-en-zh/]Johren[/url]]
translation:
普通男子诚治在自家附近的公园遇见了另一位魔法少女天才——神秘的玛雅·克林克！她冷淡的魅力与可能隐藏的动机令诚治十分在意；正当他想开口时，一名魔人突然出现，揭露了玛雅的真实身份：她是一名残酷的女战士，为了获得黑暗魔法而与邪恶合作……

诚治大吃一惊，却同意成为玛雅的使魔，也就是“卫星”，帮助她们击败另一名敌对魔人的恶魔大军。他也将获得一系列强大能力，但代价是被魔法缎带紧紧束缚于玛雅身边，与她全天候相连！命运注定，这条绳索是诚治获得稳定魔力的关键，否则他作为卫星的身体就会在凡间崩溃。

他立刻被迫与美丽的玛雅同居，并很快发现她“独特”的盲点——无论好坏，她在忠诚却越来越烦恼的主人公面前始终毫无防备，导致许多可疑的擦边与险些酿成的事故……这场意外的夏日同居会在两人之间激起别的感情吗？还是诚治永远只能做她的契约仆人？
